pipeline.license_origin: Internal (KalVista). Royalty stream sold to DRI Healthcare; Japan licensed to Kaken; Canada to Pendopharm.

indications.indication: Hereditary angioedema (HAE) - on-demand treatment in pediatric patients ages 2-11 (orally disintegrating tablet)
indications.trial_name: KONFIDENT-KID - Open-Label Safety/PK/Efficacy of Sebetralstat in Pediatric Patients (Ages 2-11) With HAE
indications.trial_design: Open-label Phase 3 of ODT formulation in pediatrics ages 2-11; enrollment completed Mar 2025
indications.trial_status: Completed (primary completion 2026-01-15); supports pediatric NDA supplement

indications.indication: HAE on-demand - long-term safety extension in adolescents/adults
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 open-label extension; converting participants to ODT formulation

commercial_product.indication: On-demand treatment of acute HAE attacks in patients 12 years and older
commercial_product.status: FDA approved July 2025; pivotal Phase 3 KONFIDENT (NCT05259917) met all primary/key secondary endpoints; EMA, UK MHRA, Swissmedic, TGA, HSA, Japan PMDA reviews ongoing/pending

excluded_preclinical.reason: Preclinical; under strategic review per FY2025 10-K

excluded_legacy_terminated.asset: KVD001 (intravitreal plasma kallikrein inhibitor for DME)

summary_counts.note: Sebetralstat is FDA-approved (EKTERLY); remaining active P3 trials are pediatric label extension (KONFIDENT-KID) and long-term safety extension (KONFIDENT-S).
